title: How far ahead sea surface temperature anomalies can be predicted
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 daily near-surface temperature for 1993-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), determine how far ahead monthly temperature anomalies can be predicted from the temperature record alone. Compare persistence with at least one other statistical forecast, measure the skill by lead time, season and location while keeping the years used for testing independent of those used for fitting, and explain where the predictability comes from and what limits it.
